sections.title: Three revision exercises
sections.body:
**Exercise A — Memory:** change the thread ID between the two message calls.
Predict the final message count, then run it. Explain why the saver did not merge
the two conversations.

**Exercise B — Recovery:** temporarily make the custom saver's `put_writes` a
no-op in a separate copy. Run the parallel-recovery test. Explain which guarantee
failed and why the simple counter example was insufficient to detect it.

**Exercise C — Schema:** explain the implementation difference between
`agent_state.checkpoints`, `orders_snapshots`, and `reporting.order_audit`.
The first customizes database namespace, the second requires a custom storage
contract in this course, and the third is a business projection.
